Better Briefs

Editorial2026

A working guide for people who commission design.

STATUS
Self-initiated concept
ROLE
Art direction, design and production study
OUTPUT
Selectable-text PDF / editable layouts

CONTEXT / PROBLEM

People who commission design often need a working guide that makes briefing, feedback and review easier.

Creative direction

Editorial hierarchy, roomy pacing and practical templates keep the guide useful rather than decorative.

The system

Ten pages covering contents, opener, body copy, checklist, process, worksheet, pull quote, example brief and closing action.

PRODUCTION / DELIVERY

Made to be used again.

Selectable-text publication PDF and editable vector pages with original copy.

Design outcome

The finished study demonstrates a repeatable design system and production-aware decisions. No measured business result is claimed.
